title: Survival of the fittest Cox model: Pivotal variable selection for time-to-event data
abstract: arXiv:2510.19374v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We revisit Cox's proportional hazards model to improve variable selection in survival analysis. A square-root transformation of the partial likelihood renders the selection of the regularization parameter asymptotically pivotal: the baseline hazard and the censoring rate cancel exactly, and the way censoring is spread over time only enters through a bounded correction of order $1/\log n$. Using martingale residuals, we compute this penalty level by Monte Carlo without reordering the design matrix. The resulting criterion borrows from information criteria such as BIC and from penalized regression methods such as the lasso, taking the best of both. On simulated and real data, our method substantially improves upon state-of-the-art approaches used daily.

translated_title: 适者生存的Cox模型：针对时间-事件数据的枢轴变量选择方法
translated_abstract: 我们重新审视了Cox比例风险模型，以改进生存分析中的变量选择。通过对偏似然函数进行平方根变换，使得正则化参数的选择在渐近意义下成为枢轴量：基线风险与删失率被精确地抵消，而删失在时间上的分布方式仅通过一个阶为 $1/\log n$ 的有界修正项产生影响。利用鞅残差，我们通过蒙特卡洛方法计算该惩罚水平，而无需对设计矩阵进行重新排序。所得的准则融合了BIC等信息准则与lasso等惩罚回归方法的优点，取两者之长。在模拟数据和真实数据上，我们的方法显著优于日常使用的最先进方法。
tldr: 本文通过对Cox比例风险模型的偏似然函数进行平方根变换，使正则化参数选择具有渐近枢轴性（精确消除基线风险和删失率的影响），从而显著提升了生存分析中变量选择的准确性和可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper achieves asymptotically pivotal regularization parameter selection in Cox's proportional hazards model through a square-root transformation of the partial likelihood, which exactly cancels out the baseline hazard and censoring rate, substantially improving variable selection in survival analysis.
